summary.text: Colton Stidam is the Democratic candidate for the Ohio House of Representatives, District 76, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after winning the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary.
An IT specialist in public schools, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that his priorities are public school funding, affordability and union support.

paragraphs.text: Colton Stidam earned a high school diploma from Shelby High School.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as IT specialist.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Stidam said he is 29, works on IT in public school systems, and comes from union roots.
Stidam's key messages in the survey were funding public schools, affordability and union support.
On affordability, he said people on fixed or low incomes should not be priced out of their homes by property taxes and that affordable housing should be built.
He said the statehouse should not advance bills that would strip away collective bargaining rights.
